cohort: The study included 478 women with spontaneous preterm labor and a gestational age-matched control group with term pregnancies.
finding: While several hematological parameters and inflammatory markers differed significantly between preterm and term groups, their predictive value for adverse neonatal outcomes remained limited.
cross-section timing: Blood samples were collected prior to the onset of labor.
birth_weight: Birth weight was measured as an outcome for the neonatal cohort.
gest_age: Women with spontaneous preterm labor (gestational age < 37 weeks) were compared to a gestational age-matched control group who delivered at term.
